integrity.computation_scope: exact arithmetic over F_5 and F_7 only
integrity.proof_status: self-reviewed mathematical proof and reproducible finite witness checks

scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the prime orders five and seven; it gives no formula for other orders.
The lower bound for order seven uses a secant-intersection argument for five-point sets; a finite exact-arithmetic checker independently cross-checks all 1,906,884 such subsets.
Literature searches are not a proof of global novelty, and independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact geometric domination numbers for the prime tori of orders five and seven
